brief.text:
SITUATION NOW
Open Cosmos secures €300M, Europe at acute risk of marginalisation, and Sweden’s evolving foodtech ecosystem. [1]
Latvia chooses Czech howitzers over Swedish Archer offer. [3]
Latvia to buy Czech artillery system instead of original Swedish option. [4]
Sweden’s Right-Wing Reckoning. [5]

WHAT THIS MEANS FOR SWEDEN
The selection of Czech howitzers over the Swedish Archer offer implies a shift in Latvia's defence procurement away from Sweden. [3]
The rejection of the original Swedish option for a Czech artillery system suggests a loss of a defence export opportunity for Sweden. [4]

KEY RISKS
Europe is at acute risk of marginalisation, which may affect Sweden's position in the space and technology sectors. [1]

WATCH ITEMS
Sweden’s evolving foodtech ecosystem and the right-wing reckoning are ongoing developments that may produce further changes. [1]
Sweden’s Right-Wing Reckoning remains an unresolved political dynamic. [5]
